summary:
Our project is a video that tells a story about the things that have been forgotten on the Moon. We decided to make Ham the chimpanzee the main character. He was the first hominid to travel into space. When he arrives on the Moon, he discovers some scientific instruments that Apollo 11 left behind for research.
Our purpose is to show that objects abandoned in space are not simply forgotten things, but important pieces of history. Through a short children’s story in video format, we want to teach children about Ham and the Apollo 11 mission.
details:
We searched for information on the internet and created the structure of our story. Then, we used artificial intelligence to turn our draft into a complete story.

We used artificial intelligence to create the images and narration, and we used the Alight Motion application to edit the video.
